method.input: JSON-lines native two-contact touch through mobile-playtest.mjs
method.inspection: Only helper --help, own screenshots, visible UI/helper output, own evidence filenames and report. No game source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings, internal state or target metadata inspected.
method.deployment: act tap #deploy + capture; attempt two act tap #play-again + capture from visible START FRESH. No checkpoint retry or third attempt.
method.observation: Every screenshot viewed separately before dependent adaptive input. At most one new scene target per batch; FIRE anchored afterward. Planning map visibly closed. Wait steps <=12000ms; 12000ms request shortened to ~2982ms. Subsequent ~3000ms requests often shortened; actual timings and boundaries preserved in actions.jsonl.

learningBetweenAttempts: Learned that HOLD ROUTE changes to HOLD APPROACH at receiver range and survivor recovery changes objective.
Learned visible numbered coil AIM markers accept scene targeting and OFF confirms completion.
Recognized scenery-targeting mistake from attempt one and selected clearly visible patrols in attempt two.
Re-engaged AIM after pause; did not assume zoom survived helper lifecycle.
Used observed route/coil behavior to proceed, without claiming score changes are causal evidence of control quality.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptionally clear and comfortable across assessed content. Scores are holistic judgments of these two synthetic paused attempts, not win/loss grades, benchmarks or physical-device certification.

overallMobile.reason: Coherent playable mission with useful touch assists and strong progress feedback; target recognition and camera/control coordination remain noticeable friction. Paused observation limits confidence about sustained comfort.

controls.reason: Two-contact MOVE/FIRE drag, scene swipe, AIM and DASH visibly responded. Zoomed patrol engagement worked. Scenery mis-target, cover shots and burst lift prompt prevented a friction-free assessment; continuous rearming remains unassessed.

gameplay.reason: Recovery, coil disable and deck upload form a clear changing objective sequence. Patrol combat and incomplete coil/reload correction added decisions. Much traversal was assisted; broader tactics, balance and continuous enjoyment unassessed.

presentation.reason: Rainy relay architecture, teal lighting, wet-looking surfaces, weapon view and consistent HUD give a cohesive atmosphere. Gray scenery reduces target separation. Audio and hardware frame pacing unassessed.

usability.reason: Large labeled controls, contextual route/approach action, paused planning map, automatic reload, objective updates and clear START FRESH/result stats helped completion. Dense right-side actions and LAST-vs-current threat interpretation add friction.

readability.reason: Objectives, health/ammo, survivor checks, coil percentages and upload bar read clearly. Small world labels, map details and gray patrol silhouettes were harder at 844x390.
